Description: Fragments of a Hebrew copy of Ecclesiastes (Qohelet) from Qumran Cave 4, in Herodian script. It is the smaller of the two Qumran Ecclesiastes copies: the published count gives it about 21 words against about 125 for 4Q109, preserving only Ecclesiastes 1:10-15, including the saying that there is nothing new under the sun.
Significance: A second, independent early witness to the opening chapter of Ecclesiastes, confirming the book's early circulation alongside the older 4Q109 copy.
